claims.statement: Only openspec/specs/** is the current contract; active openspec/changes/<name>/ are proposals and openspec/changes/archive/** is frozen historical until delta requirements graduate via opsx:archive.
The root openspec.yaml is a guardrail that enforces action read-and-reference over patterns .agents/**/*.md and docs/**/*.md.

openspec/config.yaml selects schema: spec-driven and defines context plus per-artifact rules for proposal, design, and tasks that bind every change to task-start → task-closeout → learning-distill → docs-lint.

An active change directory holds .openspec.yaml with schema and created date, mandatory proposal.md, generated design.md and tasks.md, and optional capability-scoped delta specs at specs/<capability>/spec.md using ADDED/MODIFIED delta semantics against graduated specs.

Graduated specs live under openspec/specs/<capability>/spec.md as durable SHALL requirements; ten capabilities are now graduated including aksk-bootstrap, agents-md-bootstrap, install-lanes, agent-integration-spread plus wiki-contract, distill-routing, cross-tool-lint, closeout-change-linking, openspec-integration and remove-write-plan.

add-task-start introduces a proactive task-start that creates .agents/sessions/YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-short-topic/ and seeds summary.json with task_id, created_at, status in_progress and optional openspec_change; task-closeout finalizes the same file preserving task_id and openspec_change and appending completed_at, final status and validation, falling back to generation when no seed exists.

Neither task-start nor task-closeout creates or edits durable knowledge (openwiki/, .agents/AGENTS.md, workflows, skills); they only write under .agents/sessions/<bundle>/ plus idempotent .agents/sessions/README.md and .agents/.gitignore entries.

canonical-universal-install makes ~/.agents/skills (universal Codex default) plus the self-reported current host via npx skills add -g -a <self-reported> <source> the canonical store for AKSK and langchain-ai/openwiki; extra -a <other> or --all only with explicit user request at install time.
The clone fallback git clone --depth 1 && cp -r .agents/skills is removed; npx is required and the bootstrap INSTRUCT lane reports missing npx as a prerequisite instead of silently copying.

Bootstrap is tightened to two verbs: verify CLIs (openspec/openwiki on PATH, npm i -g in user scope with caret from references/versions.json via versionsFromPackageJson) then verify skills (~/.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md presence and npx skills add -g -a <self-reported> if missing) with openwiki two-track for MCP.

Bootstrap invariants include preflight detection of Node major version (>=22), openspec/openwiki on PATH, .agents/openspec/openwiki trees and .openwiki-install.json receipts before any write, once-per-user global lane, per-repo scaffolding via openspec init, minimal .agents scaffold, append-only contract attachment and routing merge preserving any existing OpenWiki block, never-half-install clean exit without partial state, and idempotent re-run.

agents-md-bootstrap seeds a missing root AGENTS.md from the vendored FerroxLabs baseline wrapped in AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE marker with provenance header and orders zones as baseline → OPENWIKI:START/END → AKSK:ROUTING/AKSK:LIFECYCLE; refresh via refresh_agents_baseline.mjs touches only the baseline zone.

When root AGENTS.md already exists, init_agents_md.mjs must not overwrite silently: it exits non-zero presenting replace vs combine and only overwrites with --replace or stages existing plus baseline side-by-side under .agents/sessions/agents-md-combine/<timestamp>/ with --combine for agent merge.

Agent integration spread selects per host: openwiki integrations install <codex|claude|opencode> when supported (skill+MCP atomically with .openwiki-install.json receipt) otherwise npx skills add --full-depth plus npx add-mcp/openwiki mcp --host; any target already holding .openwiki-install.json is skipped as owned by the official lane.

install-lanes defines the preferred lane as agent-assisted via aksk-bootstrap (npx skills add or bootstrap.mjs) and fallback as npx skills add, and forbids an example/ directory or generate-example skill as an install method.
Spec updates happen at opsx:archive time, not at task-closeout; task-closeout records openspec_change in summary.json and leaves openspec/ untouched while the change is in-flight.

wiki-contract requires contract attachment to append the AKSK curation section to an existing openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md, never creating the file, idempotent by marker detection and stub-aware, and failing fast with openwiki --init when uninitialized; every skill invoking openspec/openwiki verifies the binary on PATH first.

cross-tool-lint repurposes docs-lint into routing-block integrity across all AGENTS.md zones, archived-change ↔ wiki coverage pairing with recorded-deferral exemption, and stale-page detection for superseded decisions; index and log regeneration is out of scope.

distill-routing routes descriptive lessons to OpenWiki OKF pages under openwiki/decisions|troubleshooting with aksk_status lifecycle and preserve-and-link semantics, and prescriptive lessons to .agents/; distillation fails closed when openwiki binary or contract is missing.

Validation is two-layer: portable scripts/check-agents-structure.sh checks shape of a target .agents tree and session tracking via git ls-files, while scripts/check-publish.sh delegates to it then adds remark formatting, markdown-link-check --alive 200,0, RG leakage scans and .agents/.agents hygiene; pre-publish sequences sync_wiki_indexes.mjs → docs-lint → check-publish.sh and openspec validate --strict gates archival.
